title: Standard Error Biases When Using Generated Regressors in Accounting Research

scopes.description: Complete supplied workflow: MATLAB Figure 4 simulation → SAS2 bootstrap → MATLAB3/4 plots; a separate MATLAB Table 2 simulation; and SAS Table 1, staged Table 3 Compustat/litigation → IBES → regression, and Table 4 applications. The three packaged XLSX files are PERMNO/DATADATE sample identifiers, not full analytic panels. Figure 4 producer/export statements are commented, so scope closure remains incomplete for that specific edge pending the three supported unapplied edits.

requirements.description: Compustat North America Fundamentals Annual panel required by Table 1, Table 3 and Table 4. The prepared `cleandat.compustat` input must supply PERMNO, DATADATE, annual accounting fields and the exact SIC/SICH variables used by the code. Required history follows the 2015 Table 1 joins and the 1996–2010 Table 3/Table 4 samples with authored lags/leads; exact edge observations are unverified.

routes.description: The one-row COMP.FUNDA header has GVKEY, DATADATE and the named annual accounting fields (including AT, IBC, IB, SALE, RECT, CEQ, DLC, DLTT, PRCC_F, CSHO, OANCF, XIDOC and PPEGT), and the separate CCM link candidate has GVKEY/LPERMNO/effective dates. FUNDA has no PERMNO or SIC column (it has SICH); the author-consumed cleandat.compustat producer, GVKEY-to-PERMNO link selection, exact SIC/SICH mapping and period coverage are not verified.
